description_en: HuggingFace model: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B. Pipeline: image-text-to-text. Downloads: 7,509,924.

title: Empacer
description_en: The voice-first assistant for small business owners. Most small business owners face the same problem when trying to use AI tools: they don't have time for re-explaining their business in every chat. Empacer is designed to skip this part. Three questions at setup, then spoken requests become a ready plan and finished work: customer replies, social posts, invoices and more. Nothing is sent without the owner's approval.

title: Dedica
description_en: Check if AI agents can use your website. Dedica tests your website the way AI agents use it, then gives your team a fix for every place they fail. Muse, Instinct, GrokBot and other agents now browse, compare and sign up on people's behalf. Dedica runs 125 checks (for free) to see if they can use your site, and gives you a fix for every issue to hand to your coding agent.

title: bytemail
description_en: Native Mac email: every inbox, in your notch, no trackers. bytemail is a native Mac email app built in Swift. Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Yahoo, Fastmail and any IMAP account in one fast window. New mail and sign-in codes grow out of your MacBook's notch, Undo Send flies a paper plane through it, and desktop widgets show what's unread. Tracking pixels are blocked, look-alike senders flagged, and your mail never touches our servers. Snooze, rules, one-click unsubscribe, and an MCP server for Claude and other AI apps. iPhone beta included. 7-day free trial.

title: BotGauge
description_en: The trust layer for your agents . AI agents don't just generate answers anymore. They take actions, call tools, and access real data. BotGauge helps engineering teams find where agents break before users do. Run adaptive red-team attacks and evals, catch security and behavioral failures, and replay every issue with full traces. Turn failures into regression tests, continuously retest as your agents evolve, and monitor their behavior in production. One reliability layer from development to deployment.

title: Fraud Blocker
description_en: AI ad fraud protection for Google and Meta ads. Fraud Blocker is an AI-powered platform that blocks invalid ad traffic from bots, click farms, and AI agents, ensuring enterprises, marketers, and agencies pay only for real clicks and genuine leads. It uses AI agents trained on billions of clicks and IPs to identify sophisticated invalid traffic that traditional filters miss, then explains why each click or IP was blocked. This helps protect budgets, improve conversion quality, and reduce wasted ad spend.

title: Scape
description_en: An intelligent email inbox that works for you. Imagine opening your inbox and finding everything already organized, with replies ready to review. Scape is an intelligent email client that prioritizes messages, prepares contextual drafts, and helps track conversations and follow-ups. It understands your work across emails, meetings, calendars, and attachments, so you can spend less time managing communication and more time moving work forward.

title: Tulu
description_en: Autonomous marketing operations & analytics for SMBs. Say ta-ta to manual work, and get the right answers without messing with UTMs, spreadsheets or...anything else. See where marketing spend produces revenue, and get alerts straight to WhatsApp when something actually needs your attention. Integrate offline spend, share views to align the entire team, and finally stop guessing with your budget. Get to the insights that matter, so you can decide exactly where to put your next euro.

title: Trigger.dev: Webhooks for your AI agents
description_en: Run AI agents with Slack, Supabase and 50+ other services. Trigger.dev Webhooks let you build AI agents on top of the services your customers already use, like Slack, Supabase and Stripe. A GitHub pull request can start a code review agent, a new Sentry issue can start an agent that writes the fix, and a Stripe refund can wait for a human to approve it in Slack.

title: Floot in ChatGPT
description_en: Build and publish real apps without leaving ChatGPT. Floot is now a native app in your ChatGPT sidebar. Describe what you want, watch it build in a live preview inside the chat, and publish it with a real link. Database, logins and hosting are built in, and the AI runs on your ChatGPT plan.

title: LFM3 by Liquid AI
description_en: Six 2B-class models for phones, laptops and robots. LFM3 is Liquid AI’s third generation of Liquid Foundation Models, with open weights and a shared backbone across text, vision, audio, omni and decision models. The first release is six 2B-class models, including a 1.7B text model that fits in about 1 GB at 4-bit and has a 256K context. Liquid says they run on phones, laptops and edge devices and can be fine-tuned on one GPU. Weights are on Hugging Face.

title: Gologin Cloud Browser
description_en: Cloud browser for AI agents and tough sites . Gologin Cloud Browser gives AI agents and scrapers real Chromium browsers that stay logged in. Persistent sessions survive across runs, so there’s no re-auth or lost state. Built-in stealth and anti-bot protection, plus proxies in 150+ countries. Fully serverless, it scales to thousands of browsers and works with Playwright and Puppeteer via WebSocket. Built by the GoLogin team: 7 years’ expertise, SOC 2 Type II, 99.9% SLA. Plans from $4.50/mo.

title: Gemini 4 Carbon
description_en:
Google's next frontier model. Gemini 4 Carbon is our strongest model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon capabilities.

description_en: Turn a prompt into a living world you can steer. Genie 4 is Google DeepMind’s new real-time world model for creators, game developers and AI researchers. Unlike video generators that hand you a finished clip, Genie 4 builds a world you walk through with your keyboard and steer with text as it runs: change the weather, add a character, set an event in motion. It generates native audio and live dialogue, simulates physics and natural human motion, and uses Gemini to keep scenes coherent. Research preview, waitlist open now.

title: Zro: Uncensored Security Models
description_en: Abliterated open models for security work. Run them through the Zro API or CLI with zero request retention. Since our July launch, we’ve also added new models, agent integrations, yearly plans, and referrals.

title: OpenLLM
description_en: Take your AI tokens anywhere. Take your tokens anywhere. Use your subscriptions, API keys and local models in Codex and any coding agent, or inside the ChatGPT app on your Mac. Hit a limit and it keeps going. Start a coding session on your home machine from anywhere.

title: Radar
description_en: You don't need an AI SRE. Give your agent Radar.. Your agent knows Kubernetes. It doesn't know your cluster. Radar (open-source) gives it context over MCP: ranked issues, a change timeline, logs and owners in one view. New: click Investigate on a failing workload. Claude Code, Codex or Cursor finds the root cause, read-only, with evidence for each claim. In our benchmark of 50 live faults across six tools, Radar found the most root causes. Radar Cloud investigates every alert and posts findings to Slack.

title: Hob
description_en: Open-source, on device alternative to Claude and ChatGPT. Hob is a free, open-source AI app for Mac, Windows and Linux that works with your files the way ChatGPT and Claude do, except the AI runs on your own computer. It picks the best open model your computer can run and sets it up for you. Hob can read and edit files in folders you choose, turn spreadsheets into charts, fill in PDFs, look at photos and search the web. Your chats and files stay on your computer, and it works offline.

title: Viggle JST-2
description_en: JST-2: 3D scenes, characters and motion from one model. JST-2 is Viggle’s physics-native world foundation model for generating 3D scenes, characters and full-body motion in one shared world. Scenes take about one second, characters come from one image or text with motion built in, and motion comes from text or video. Try it free in the PINOC browser app, or use the API or MCP with agents like Claude Code. Benchmarks are Viggle’s own blind human tests.

title: IFTTT.ai
description_en: The easiest way to automate anything. IFTTT is now IFTTT.ai, and every plan now includes our core features and all 1,000+ services, from multiple actions and filters to queries and Webhooks. Pricing is credit-based, and you can build unlimited Applets for free. AI got an upgrade too. AI Agent watches web pages for price changes or new listings, AI Action assist writes each action based on its trigger, and AI queries run on better models. Or describe an automation in IFTTT Chat and it builds the Applet for you.

title: TopAgent
description_en: Drive B2B event attendance with an AI agent. Fill your next B2B conference, summit, or workshop with SMS invitations and relevant follow-ups. Give TopAgent your opted-in audience, event details, registration link, and deadline. It prepares the campaign, monitors delivery, clicks, and replies, and returns with follow-ups ready for your approval.

title: throxy
description_en: Cold calls in your prospect's language. Pipeline delivered.. throxy is Y Combinator's first AI native sales agency, booking qualified sales meetings for B2B companies selling into industries where generic outreach fails: manufacturing, logistics, construction. We build lists using proprietary tech, then our sales reps call your buyers. New this month: calls routed to an SDR who speaks the lead's language, so a plant manager in Lyon hears French + a buyer in Munich hears German. You pay for meetings you accept that actually happen. [All SDRs are humans]

title: Intrascope 2.0
description_en: New AI agent, 1,650+ apps, Skills and smart model routing. What's different: ChatGPT and Claude lock you into one vendor. Intrascope 2.0 gives your team 120+ models (GPT-6, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Qwen) plus an AI agent that works in 1,650+ apps like Gmail, Slack, Drive and Notion. The company stays in control: admins approve apps and models, set budgets per team, project and person, and see every token and dollar. New in 2.0: agent, connectors, Skills, Auto routing, full redesign. Private and on-prem deployments for enterprise.

description_en:
Let websites use AI running on your computer. You can now access local AI built into the browser to start creating your own browser capabilities instead of relying on others' extensions.

description_en: The Mac app for the coding agents you already use. Yardlet is a free, open-source Mac app for the coding agents you already use. title: OutreachGuy
description_en: The AI SDR that works the leads you never followed up. Most leads never get a second message.
